 Bahrain’s military says air defence systems have thwarted “treacherous” Iranian attacks and condemned Tehran’s “systematic aggression” against the Gulf kingdom.
 Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warns Iran will not remain in a situation of “neither war nor peace” and threatens to expand the geographical scope of the conflict if the US “makes a mistake”.
